title: Nostalgic Sweet Argentinian Beef Wrap
description: Sweet, tender beef wrapped in fragrant pandan leaves, a nostalgic Argentinian-inspired treat.
instructions: Trim the beef sirloin into thin strips and season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of brown sugar.
Heat rendered beef fat in a pan over medium heat until hot.
Add the beef strips to the pan and sear until browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in soy sauce and maple syrup, then add coconut milk and stir to combine.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the beef is tender.
While the beef simmers, soften the pandan leaves in hot water for 1 minute.
Lay a softened pandan leaf flat, place a Chinese leaf lettuce leaf, and spoon about 2 tablespoons of the beef mixture onto it.
Fold the edges of the pandan leaf over the filling and roll tightly to form a wrap.
Repeat steps 8-9 until all beef is used.
Optionally, warm the wraps in a dry skillet for 1 minute on each side to seal the edges.
